label: The box K node excludes the subtraction contingency premise at its world
meaning: If the box K necessary-being node holds at w (some actual concrete root n, God with the classical attributes, exists at every world accessible from w), then not every concrete object existing at w is absent at some accessible world: n exists at w and would be absent at an accessible world where it exists. A checked incompatibility between the node and subtraction premise A2 at the node's world. With excluded middle, A2 at w is exactly the denial of the stage-one node STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-AT (controls), so the theist route rejects A2 for the necessary being and no other subtraction premise (theist model).

strong_version_needed.cdf897a8-5490-561a-b9d2-507486a3f192: Logically the weaker stage-one node STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-AT (some concrete individual exists at w and at every accessible world) already excludes A2 at w, and with excluded middle A2 at w is exactly its denial (controls, laws 1 and 8). That node links the NECESSARY_11 frame-carrier definition beside NECESSARY_2 (legacy carrier classification recorded in DISAMB-NECESSARY), so an argument from it would mix senses without a registered bridge; the box K node uses NECESSARY_2 alone. The incompatibility is recorded at the node the route's cheapest path concludes, as for result 065a9092.
